## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.

Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.

Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.

completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.

What observation would distinguish that consequence from legitimate behavior? Use a baseline, a controlled variation and the evidence needed to tell them apart. Supporting and refuting outcomes must address the same claimed consequence; an ordinary intermediate effect is not that consequence. Future identity comparisons must agree with declared authentication requirements, even when credentials are not yet available. ## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.
Authenticated identity comparison required by this work. none requests no comparison between authenticated accounts, roles, or tenants; it can still require authenticated sessions. Anonymous controls are separate from this mode.
Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.
Retain grounded conditional hypotheses when proposed controls can resolve uncertainty;
completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.
For repairable grounding or identity requirements, request revise. Explain the deficient claim or test
and the missing distinction in the existing check reason; do not demand execution of future tests.
Request inspection only for concrete necessary evidence that is missing or unexamined. A reasoned
empty disposition is valid when inspected observations support no security-relevant test. Apply this
rubric to the assigned mechanism, not a keyword checklist. Python owns bookkeeping; semantic judgments
belong to the model.

conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.

trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link

## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.

completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an

What observation would distinguish that consequence from legitimate behavior? Use a baseline, a controlled variation and the evidence needed to tell them apart. ## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.
Authenticated identity comparison required by this work. none requests no comparison between authenticated accounts, roles, or tenants; it can still require authenticated sessions. Anonymous controls are separate from this mode.
Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.
Retain grounded conditional hypotheses when proposed controls can resolve uncertainty;
completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.
For repairable grounding or identity requirements, request revise. Explain the deficient claim or test
and the missing distinction in the existing check reason; do not demand execution of future tests.
Request inspection only for concrete necessary evidence that is missing or unexamined. A reasoned
empty disposition is valid when inspected observations support no security-relevant test. Apply this
rubric to the assigned mechanism, not a keyword checklist. Python owns bookkeeping; semantic judgments
belong to the model.

Include subject_reviews. Review each current subject exactly once with
item_id, decision (retain|revise|withdraw), reason, and hypotheses. Each hypothesis entry must contain

## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.
Authenticated identity comparison required by this work. none requests no comparison between authenticated accounts, roles, or tenants; it can still require authenticated sessions. Anonymous controls are separate from this mode.
Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.
Retain grounded conditional hypotheses when proposed controls can resolve uncertainty;
completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.
For repairable grounding or identity requirements, request revise. Explain the deficient claim or test
and the missing distinction in the existing check reason; do not demand execution of future tests.
Request inspection only for concrete necessary evidence that is missing or unexamined. A reasoned
empty disposition is valid when inspected observations support no security-relevant test. Apply this
rubric to the assigned mechanism, not a keyword checklist. Python owns bookkeeping; semantic judgments
belong to the model.

Keep observed facts, assumptions and unresolved prerequisites explicit. Identify expected legitimate behavior and the suspected security consequence. What observation would distinguish that consequence from legitimate behavior? Use a baseline, a controlled variation and the evidence needed to tell them apart. Supporting and refuting outcomes must address the same claimed consequence; an ordinary intermediate effect is not that consequence. Future identity comparisons must agree with declared authentication requirements, even when credentials are not yet available. Successful execution or a different response establishes only what was observed. Establish relevant policy from documentation, configuration or independently known authorized and denied baselines. Unknown implementation details can become future checks when observed behavior motivates a conditional proposal. ## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.
Authenticated identity comparison required by this work. none requests no comparison between authenticated accounts, roles, or tenants; it can still require authenticated sessions. Anonymous controls are separate from this mode.
Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.
Retain grounded conditional hypotheses when proposed controls can resolve uncertainty;
completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.
For repairable grounding or identity requirements, request revise. Explain the deficient claim or test
and the missing distinction in the existing check reason; do not demand execution of future tests.
Request inspection only for concrete necessary evidence that is missing or unexamined. A reasoned
empty disposition is valid when inspected observations support no security-relevant test. Apply this
rubric to the assigned mechanism, not a keyword checklist. Python owns bookkeeping; semantic judgments
belong to the model.

conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be

implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.

trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link

## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.
Authenticated identity comparison required by this work. none requests no comparison between authenticated accounts, roles, or tenants; it can still require authenticated sessions. Anonymous controls are separate from this mode.
Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.
Retain grounded conditional hypotheses when proposed controls can resolve uncertainty;
completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.
For repairable grounding or identity requirements, request revise. Explain the deficient claim or test
and the missing distinction in the existing check reason; do not demand execution of future tests.
Request inspection only for concrete necessary evidence that is missing or unexamined. A reasoned
empty disposition is valid when inspected observations support no security-relevant test. Apply this
rubric to the assigned mechanism, not a keyword checklist. Python owns bookkeeping; semantic judgments
belong to the model.

Keep observed facts, assumptions and unresolved prerequisites explicit. Identify expected legitimate behavior and the suspected security consequence. What observation would distinguish that consequence from legitimate behavior? Use a baseline, a controlled variation and the evidence needed to tell them apart. Supporting and refuting outcomes must address the same claimed consequence; an ordinary intermediate effect is not that consequence. Future identity comparisons must agree with declared authentication requirements, even when credentials are not yet available. Successful execution or a different response establishes only what was observed. Establish relevant policy from documentation, configuration or independently known authorized and denied baselines. ## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.
Authenticated identity comparison required by this work. none requests no comparison between authenticated accounts, roles, or tenants; it can still require authenticated sessions. Anonymous controls are separate from this mode.
Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.
Retain grounded conditional hypotheses when proposed controls can resolve uncertainty;
completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.
For repairable grounding or identity requirements, request revise. Explain the deficient claim or test
and the missing distinction in the existing check reason; do not demand execution of future tests.
Request inspection only for concrete necessary evidence that is missing or unexamined. A reasoned
empty disposition is valid when inspected observations support no security-relevant test. Apply this
rubric to the assigned mechanism, not a keyword checklist. Python owns bookkeeping; semantic judgments
belong to the model.

Summary records are not exhaustive implementation evidence. Empty input lists
mean inputs are unrecorded, not absent. Reconcile input_candidate entries from recorded inputs,

The generation task's authentication requirement governs generation only, not proposed future tests.

declared role for single-session tests, or account/role/tenant comparisons when the proposed steps
compare authenticated identities. Declare future identity needs even when sessions are not yet available.
Consider unauthenticated versus each relevant role and same-role accounts where an access boundary
supports them; different-role tests require distinct declared roles. One role is not a cross-role gap.

source references; do not infer them from names. Missing session readiness does not justify an empty
publication; propose the future prerequisites without logging in during generation.

conditional future tests: separate observed facts, assumed preconditions, and behavior the test must establish.

functionality. Neither empty inputs nor inferred methods alone justify an empty publication.

security-relevant test; do not invent hypotheses or require a minimum count. Missing optional metadata,
unexamined necessary evidence, and inspection limits do not themselves justify that disposition.
If concrete necessary evidence remains unexamined, identify the source and missing information through
existing prerequisite handling: bind source_refs to the frozen parent inventory and name the referenced
implementation artifact in missing_input. Do not treat optional absent attributes as prerequisites.
For authorization proposals, ground the intended operation and
access boundary in supplied observations or declared policy. Client token storage, date filters, and absent
server code do not establish ownership, tenants, or missing authorization. An unproved mechanism may be
conditional; do not invent the security boundary. Compare the same protected operation/resource under
appropriate authorized and unauthorized controls. Broad results, generic errors, reflection, and ordinary
functionality alone cannot establish unauthorized access. Align authentication_requirement with test steps:
account/role/tenant comparisons require corresponding identity contexts and declared roles; unauthenticated
bypass tests may use comparison=none. Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a grounded
future proposal. Do not execute proposed tests during hypothesis generation or review.
Declared roles: admin, operator, reader, auditor, user. Session readiness is unknown; future identity requirements are independent of generation-task authentication.

Keep observed facts, assumptions and unresolved prerequisites explicit. Identify expected legitimate behavior and the suspected security consequence. What observation would distinguish that consequence from legitimate behavior? Use a baseline, a controlled variation and the evidence needed to tell them apart. Supporting and refuting outcomes must address the same claimed consequence; an ordinary intermediate effect is not that consequence. Future identity comparisons must agree with declared authentication requirements, even when credentials are not yet available. Successful execution or a different response establishes only what was observed. Establish relevant policy from documentation, configuration or independently known authorized and denied baselines. Unknown implementation details can become future checks when observed behavior motivates a conditional proposal. Observed client input and data flow can provide that basis without confirmed server handling. Preserve uncertainty until the distinguishing evidence is available. 
## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.
Authenticated identity comparison required by this work. none requests no comparison between authenticated accounts, roles, or tenants; it can still require authenticated sessions. Anonymous controls are separate from this mode.
Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.
Retain grounded conditional hypotheses when proposed controls can resolve uncertainty;
completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.
For repairable grounding or identity requirements, request revise. Explain the deficient claim or test
and the missing distinction in the existing check reason; do not demand execution of future tests.
Request inspection only for concrete necessary evidence that is missing or unexamined. A reasoned
empty disposition is valid when inspected observations support no security-relevant test. Apply this
rubric to the assigned mechanism, not a keyword checklist. Python owns bookkeeping; semantic judgments
belong to the model.

Python binds publication_sha256; omit it from your response. Always include top-level status
(done|partial_failure|blocked) and repair (kind=none|acceptance|execution). Return a complete decision,
including these fields on every correction; never return only the corrected fragment.
Correction feedback identifies accepted subject reviews and invalid subjects with field paths. Preserve
accepted subject reviews exactly; reassess invalid subjects, including decisions and reasons when needed.
Include subject_reviews. Review each current subject exactly once with
item_id, decision (retain|revise|withdraw), reason, and hypotheses. Each hypothesis entry must contain
hypothesis_id, decision, reason, and semantic_checks; review every current hypothesis exactly once.
semantic_checks contains grounding and test_discrimination (verdict adequate|revise, reason), and
identity_requirements (verdict adequate|revise|not_applicable, reason). Keep each reason under 500
characters and concise. A retain decision requires no revise check. Use not_applicable only when
identity requirements are irrelevant. Grounding includes the intended access boundary; test_discrimination
checks controls and outcome specificity; identity_requirements checks declared execution identities.
Return instructions as a string,
null, or omit it when no additional instructions are needed. Structured reasons remain authoritative.

when no correction is needed, regardless of explanatory prose.

Keep observed facts, assumptions and unresolved prerequisites explicit. Identify expected legitimate behavior and the suspected security consequence. What observation would distinguish that consequence from legitimate behavior? Use a baseline, a controlled variation and the evidence needed to tell them apart. Supporting and refuting outcomes must address the same claimed consequence; an ordinary intermediate effect is not that consequence. Future identity comparisons must agree with declared authentication requirements, even when credentials are not yet available. Successful execution or a different response establishes only what was observed. Establish relevant policy from documentation, configuration or independently known authorized and denied baselines. ## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.
Authenticated identity comparison required by this work. none requests no comparison between authenticated accounts, roles, or tenants; it can still require authenticated sessions. Anonymous controls are separate from this mode.
Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.
Retain grounded conditional hypotheses when proposed controls can resolve uncertainty;
completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.
For repairable grounding or identity requirements, request revise. Explain the deficient claim or test
and the missing distinction in the existing check reason; do not demand execution of future tests.
Request inspection only for concrete necessary evidence that is missing or unexamined. A reasoned
empty disposition is valid when inspected observations support no security-relevant test. Apply this
rubric to the assigned mechanism, not a keyword checklist. Python owns bookkeeping; semantic judgments
belong to the model.

needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.

conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.

trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.

property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.

Keep observed facts, assumptions and unresolved prerequisites explicit. Identify expected legitimate behavior and the suspected security consequence. What observation would distinguish that consequence from legitimate behavior? Use a baseline, a controlled variation and the evidence needed to tell them apart. Supporting and refuting outcomes must address the same claimed consequence; an ordinary intermediate effect is not that consequence. Future identity comparisons must agree with declared authentication requirements, even when credentials are not yet available. Successful execution or a different response establishes only what was observed. Establish relevant policy from documentation, configuration or independently known authorized and denied baselines. Unknown implementation details can become future checks when observed behavior motivates a conditional proposal. ## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.
Authenticated identity comparison required by this work. none requests no comparison between authenticated accounts, roles, or tenants; it can still require authenticated sessions. Anonymous controls are separate from this mode.
Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.
Retain grounded conditional hypotheses when proposed controls can resolve uncertainty;
completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.
For repairable grounding or identity requirements, request revise. Explain the deficient claim or test
and the missing distinction in the existing check reason; do not demand execution of future tests.
Request inspection only for concrete necessary evidence that is missing or unexamined. A reasoned
empty disposition is valid when inspected observations support no security-relevant test. Apply this
rubric to the assigned mechanism, not a keyword checklist. Python owns bookkeeping; semantic judgments
belong to the model.

Python binds publication_sha256; omit it from your response. Always include top-level status

Keep observed facts, assumptions and unresolved prerequisites explicit. Identify expected legitimate behavior and the suspected security consequence. What observation would distinguish that consequence from legitimate behavior? Use a baseline, a controlled variation and the evidence needed to tell them apart. Supporting and refuting outcomes must address the same claimed consequence; an ordinary intermediate effect is not that consequence. Future identity comparisons must agree with declared authentication requirements, even when credentials are not yet available. Successful execution or a different response establishes only what was observed. Establish relevant policy from documentation, configuration or independently known authorized and denied baselines. Unknown implementation details can become future checks when observed behavior motivates a conditional proposal. Observed client input and data flow can provide that basis without confirmed server handling. Preserve uncertainty until the distinguishing evidence is available. 
## Hypothesis semantic rubric
Use frozen inventory and retained source artifacts; inspect explicitly linked retained resources when
needed. Public research may inform future tests. Do not fetch the live target or execute proposed tests.
Name concrete necessary missing evidence as a prerequisite gap, not as a negative observation.
Grounding concerns the observed basis, not proof of a proposed outcome. Keep observed facts,
conditional mechanism assumptions and future outcomes distinct. A source-backed mechanism may be
proposed conditionally when relevant observations motivate it and future checks establish whether
it applies; do not demand observed exploitation, protected response content or confirmed server-side
implementation merely to retain such a proposal. An unrelated or invented observation remains a defect.
Grounding: connect inspected observations to the assigned subject, proposed mechanism, and intended
trust boundary. Distinguish observed facts from unresolved preconditions. An explicitly evidenced link
to a related resource can ground a workflow hypothesis; the tested action need not use the subject's
literal path. For example, a page can call a backend API. Unrelated resources remain outside the
assignment. Inferred GET operations and unrecorded inputs do not restrict a subject to its page response.
Positive expectations describe the claimed security consequence.
Under test_discrimination, compare positive expectations with legitimate and control outcomes.
Explain any missing distinction in the existing check reason. For example, accepting an upload body
is ordinary file-write behavior; a mass-assignment test needs an unauthorized effect on a protected
property, with structured binding established as a future prerequisite if unknown. A SPA shell alone
cannot establish unauthorized access; distinguish access to protected data or actions. For network
and filesystem checks, compare access against the applicable connection policy or file entitlement.
Identity requirements: declared identities and comparisons must match the proposed future tests.
Authenticated identity comparison required by this work. none requests no comparison between authenticated accounts, roles, or tenants; it can still require authenticated sessions. Anonymous controls are separate from this mode.
Missing execution credentials alone do not invalidate a future test plan.
Retain grounded conditional hypotheses when proposed controls can resolve uncertainty;
completed exploitation is not required. Request revise for repairable tests and withdraw for an
ungrounded premise.
For repairable grounding or identity requirements, request revise. Explain the deficient claim or test
and the missing distinction in the existing check reason; do not demand execution of future tests.
Request inspection only for concrete necessary evidence that is missing or unexamined. A reasoned
empty disposition is valid when inspected observations support no security-relevant test. Apply this
rubric to the assigned mechanism, not a keyword checklist. Python owns bookkeeping; semantic judgments
belong to the model.

## Required hypothesis review output
Python binds publication_sha256; omit it from your response. Always include top-level status
(done|partial_failure|blocked) and repair (kind=none|acceptance|execution). Return a complete decision,
including these fields on every correction; never return only the corrected fragment.
Correction feedback identifies accepted subject reviews and invalid subjects with field paths. Preserve
accepted subject reviews exactly; reassess invalid subjects, including decisions and reasons when needed.
Include subject_reviews. Review each current subject exactly once with
item_id, decision (retain|revise|withdraw), reason, and hypotheses. Each hypothesis entry must contain
hypothesis_id, decision, reason, and semantic_checks; review every current hypothesis exactly once.
semantic_checks contains grounding and test_discrimination (verdict adequate|revise, reason), and
identity_requirements (verdict adequate|revise|not_applicable, reason). Keep each reason under 500
characters and concise. A retain decision requires no revise check. Use not_applicable only when
identity requirements are irrelevant. Grounding includes the intended access boundary; test_discrimination
checks controls and outcome specificity; identity_requirements checks declared execution identities.
Return instructions as a string,
null, or omit it when no additional instructions are needed. Structured reasons remain authoritative.
For a subject with no hypotheses include no_hypothesis_basis with kind (inspected_evidence,
metadata_only, necessary_evidence_unreviewed) and inspection_refs. A retained empty disposition
requires inspected_evidence and at least one content-bearing saved inspection. Python labels availability;
metadata-only references may supplement content but cannot establish inspected behavior.
The bound schema selects the empty-review form. When reconciled input candidates are supplied,
require behavior_assessments INSIDE subject_reviews[].no_hypothesis_basis, with observed_behavior,
inspection_refs, input_candidate_ids, supports_conditional_test, and reasoning.
Assess every reconciled input candidate ID before retaining an empty result. Match source-derived
candidates to saved inspections of their source locations. An input does not itself require a hypothesis.
For populated subjects omit no_hypothesis_basis; never add behavior_assessments at the subject level.
Address relevant observed interactions and trust boundaries, including evidence
returned before the checkpoint; do not rely solely on the publication's chosen citations.
When no reconciled input candidates are supplied, require no_relevant_behavior_reason inside
no_hypothesis_basis instead of behavior_assessments. Explain why the inspected observations support
no conditional security test; if they support a test, request publication repair instead.
Each assessment must cite content-bearing basis inspection_refs. If any assessment supports a conditional test,
request publication repair (repair.kind=acceptance); do not retain completed empty coverage.
Judge the content's semantic adequacy; a valid reference alone is not support. Metadata-only grounds
require publication repair; necessary unreviewed evidence requires explicit prerequisite_gaps and
inspection recovery. Inputs-unrecorded and inferred-operation diagnostics are never independent
grounds for completed empty coverage. Read saved results with read_inspection_result when needed.
A reasoned no_testable_hypotheses disposition is successful coverage: not every inventory item has a
supported security implication. Review its reason against frozen observations and the resolved source/inspection
context, including direct and explicitly linked inputs. Request acceptance repair when the reason
contradicts recorded inputs; an input alone does not mandate a hypothesis. If concrete relevant
implementation remains unexamined and is necessary to assess the subject,
request focused prerequisite inspection rather than accepting missing metadata as negative evidence.
Do not require every available source to be inspected. Read/search success establishes inspection only,
not semantic support or exhaustive coverage. Do not demand speculative
hypotheses. No hypothesis does not prove no vulnerability. Assess whether relevant unauthenticated,
authenticated, same-role account, different-role, or tenant scenarios were overlooked; request targeted
publication repair when supported by frozen observations and declared identity context.
Do not require an unauthenticated counterpart for every authenticated hypothesis.
For revisions or withdrawals without prerequisite gaps use repair.kind=acceptance. When a concrete
necessary prerequisite also requires inspection, use repair.kind=execution first and retain all requested
publication revisions; inspect the identified sources, then republish and review the corrected digest.
An unavailable external prerequisite is blocked even when publication revisions remain pending.
Return review feedback only; the actor uses revise_hypothesis for requested individual corrections;
Python preserves unaffected records. Do not put replacement subjects or mode in the repair object.
An empty hypothesis list with a sound reason is valid.
Use prerequisite_gaps for concrete information necessary to assess a frozen criterion that is unavailable
or remains unexamined in supplied evidence, with criterion_id, missing_input,
item_ids and frozen source_refs. Optional absent metadata is not a prerequisite. Set repair.kind=none
when no correction is needed, regardless of explanatory prose.
For unmet frozen acceptance criteria, include unresolved_criterion_ids and a concrete top-level reason.
Do not use partial_failure when every review is retain and no criterion or prerequisite remains unresolved.
